render.script: (async function(){function normalize(links){var arr=Array.from(links);if(!arr.length)return;var parsed=arr.map(function(link,i){var numEl=link.querySelector('.title-detail__row-num');var text=(numEl?numEl.textContent:'').trim();var m=text.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);var num=m?parseFloat(m[1]):null;return{link:link,numEl:numEl,text:text.toLowerCase(),num:num,idx:i};});var validNums=parsed.map(function(x){return x.num;}).filter(function(n){return n!==null;});var max=validNums.length>0?Math.max.apply(null,validNums):0;parsed.forEach(function(item){if(item.num!==null){item.link.setAttribute('data-number',item.num);if(item.numEl)item.numEl.setAttribute('data-number',item.num);return;}var t=item.text;var assigned=null;if(t.includes('start')||t.includes('prologue')||t.includes('intro')){assigned=0;}else if(t.includes('end')||t.includes('finale')||t.includes('final')||t.includes('epilogue')||t.includes('outro')){max+=1;assigned=max;}else{var prev=null;for(var k=item.idx-1;k>=0;k--){if(parsed[k].num!==null){prev=parsed[k].num;break;}}var next=null;for(var j=item.idx+1;j<parsed.length;j++){if(parsed[j].num!==null){next=parsed[j].num;break;}}if(prev!==null&&next!==null)assigned=(prev+next)/2;else if(prev!==null)assigned=prev+0.1;else if(next!==null)assigned=Math.max(0,next-0.1);else assigned=item.idx+1;}item.num=assigned;item.link.setAttribute('data-number',assigned);if(item.numEl)item.numEl.setAttribute('data-number',assigned);});}normalize(document.querySelectorAll('.title-detail__row a.title-detail__row-link,a.title-detail__row-link'));var wrap=document.getElementById('sumizuri-chapters');if(!wrap){wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.id='sumizuri-chapters';document.body.appendChild(wrap);}wrap.innerHTML='';var seenHrefs=new Set();function harvest(){var links=document.querySelectorAll('.title-detail__row a.title-detail__row-link,a.title-detail__row-link');links.forEach(function(a){if(a.closest('#sumizuri-chapters'))return;var href=a.getAttribute('href');if(href&&!seenHrefs.has(href)){seenHrefs.add(href);wrap.appendChild(a.cloneNode(true));}});}harvest();var nextSelector='.npager__num.is-active + .npager__num,.npager__nav[aria-label="Next page"],.npager__next,[aria-label="Next page"]';for(var p=1;p<400;p++){var nextBtn=document.querySelector(nextSelector);if(!nextBtn||nextBtn.disabled||nextBtn.getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true'||nextBtn.classList.contains('disabled')){break;}var firstEl=document.querySelector('.title-detail__row a.title-detail__row-link,a.title-detail__row-link');var firstHref=firstEl?firstEl.getAttribute('href'):null;nextBtn.click();await new Promise(function(resolve){var count=0;var iv=setInterval(function(){count++;var curFirst=document.querySelector('.title-detail__row a.title-detail__row-link,a.title-detail__row-link');var curHref=curFirst?curFirst.getAttribute('href'):null;if((curHref&&curHref!==firstHref)||count>25){clearInterval(iv);resolve();}},100);});harvest();}if(wrap.children.length>0){var origList=document.querySelector('.title-detail__list');if(origList)origList.remove();normalize(wrap.querySelectorAll('a.title-detail__row-link'));}return 'Done';})()

(function(){var el=document.querySelector('.reader,.reader__strip,.reader__paged,.reader__page');if(!el)return;var k=Object.keys(el).find(function(x){return x.startsWith('__reactFiber$')||x.startsWith('__reactInternalInstance$');});var f=k?el[k]:null;var pages=null;var visited=new Set();function search(node,depth){if(!node||depth>20||visited.has(node)||pages)return;visited.add(node);var h=node.memoizedState;while(h){var s=h.memoizedState;if(s){if(Array.isArray(s.pages)&&s.pages.length>0&&(s.pages[0].url||typeof s.pages[0]==='string')){pages=s.pages;return;}if(Array.isArray(s)&&s.length>0&&(s[0].url||typeof p.pages[0]==='string')){pages=p.pages;return;}if(node.return)search(node.return,depth+1);if(node.child)search(node.child,depth+1);if(node.sibling)search(node.sibling,depth+1);}search(f,0);var wrap=document.getElementById('sumizuri-pages');if(!wrap){wrap=document.createElement('div');wrap.id='sumizuri-pages';document.body.appendChild(wrap);}wrap.innerHTML='';if(pages&&pages.length>0){pages.forEach(function(item){var els=document.querySelectorAll('.reader__page,.reader-swiper__slide');els.forEach(function(slide){var k2=Object.keys(slide).find(function(x){return f2=k2?slide[k2]:null;while(f2&&(!f2.memoizedProps||!(f2.memoizedProps.page||(f2.memoizedProps.children&&f2.memoizedProps.children.props&&f2.memoizedProps.children.props.page)))){f2=f2.return;}var p2=f2&&f2.memoizedProps?(f2.memoizedProps.page||(f2.memoizedProps.children&&f2.memoizedProps.children.props&&f2.memoizedProps.children.props.page)):null;var url=p2&&p2.url?p2.url:(Array.isArray(p2)&&p2[0]&&p2[0].url?p2[0].url:null);if(url){var img=document.createElement('img');img.className='reader-img';img.src=url;wrap.appendChild(img);}});if(wrap.children.length>0){var r=document.querySelector('.reader');if(r)r.remove();}}})();
